I don't hike ultralight but I'm thinking about it once I get more money for gear, so I'm curious about how ultralight hikers hydrate. Water is always the heaviest thing I carry when I hike. I use a Sawyer mini filter. The Sawyer mini is nice because I can reuse the same filter essentially indefinitely as long as I take reasonable care of it.

Probably the most Ultralight option is the Aquamira tablets, but I don't like the idea of drinking the chlorine dioxide, even though it's considered safe to drink in those quantities.

When I'm at high alpine tarns and lakes away from trails I'll just drink the water without filtering. In rocky areas with little to no organic matter the water is often quite delicious.
